Descriptions.Text: No element: the hit plays no element body effect and sets no damage element for animations. On a bullet this overrides the weapon or buff element with none, since only 254 means "don't override".
Magic. A hit that deals magic damage plays the magic body effect (SFX 2003000 + size) on the victim, and ends the victim's effects with Delete Criteria Damage 8.

Fire. A hit that deals fire damage plays the burn body effect (SFX 2001000 + size, +10 for corpse burn type). It also ignites oil (state 252, SFX 4000), thaws frostbite (applies SpEffect 5247), ends effects with Delete Criteria Damage 9 (oil, frost build-up), and drives HKS fire damage and death animations.
Lightning. A hit that deals lightning damage plays the lightning body effect (SFX 2002000 + size), and ends the victim's effects with Delete Criteria Damage 10.
Holy (DAMAGE_ELEMENT_DARK in HKS). A hit that deals holy damage plays the holy body effect (SFX 2004000 + size), and ends the victim's effects with Delete Criteria Damage 11.

Poison. A hit that builds up poison plays the poison body effect (SFX 2005000 + size). On a poison effect (state info 2) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element, so dying to it uses the poison death animation.

Scarlet rot (DAMAGE_ELEMENT_BLIGHT in HKS). A hit that builds up rot plays the rot body effect (SFX 2006000 + size). On a rot effect (state info 5) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element, so dying to it uses the poison death animation.
Blood loss. A hit that builds up bleed plays the blood body effect (SFX 2007000 + size). On a blood loss effect (state info 6) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element.
Frostbite. A hit that builds up frost plays the frost body effect (SFX 2008000 + size). On a frostbite effect (state info 260) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element.
Sleep. A hit that builds up sleep plays the sleep body effect (SFX 2009000 + size). On a sleep effect (state info 436) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element.

Madness. A hit that builds up madness plays the madness body effect (SFX 2010000 + size). On a madness effect (state info 437) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element, so dying to it uses the madness death animation (also when riding).

Death blight (DAMAGE_ELEMENT_CURSE in HKS). A hit that builds up death blight plays the death blight body effect (SFX 2011000 + size). On a death blight effect (state info 116) that deals HP damage, the tick sets the damage element.

No element. On a SpEffect or bullet this means "don't override": the attack keeps the element from its AtkParam, weapon or (for SpEffects) other buffs. This is the default for SpEffect and bullet rows.
AtkParam only: use the weapon's Special Attribute and its variation value. Don't use it on a SpEffect: the weapon lookup runs before SpEffect overrides, so there it means no element.
